Fresh Cherries led sales and profit ($38,189.56 and $20,097.08); Organic Veggie Boxes had the highest sell-through (71.13%) but also the highest return rate (18.79%). Dumplings and crab legs also had relatively high return rates (12.64% and 10.19%), while cherries and ramen were under 1.5%.
